description: Extracts TikTok posts using a specific audio track or sound using apidojo's TikTok Music Scraper on Apify. Triggers when the user asks to: get all TikTok videos using a specific sound, find TikTok posts using an audio clip, scrape TikTok videos using a trending music track, export TikTok posts made with a song, find creators using a specific sound, or collect TikTok content associated with a music URL. Returns video caption, views, likes, comments, channel info, song metadata, and hashtags per post. Ideal for music marketers, trend analysts, and viral sound trackers.
